content.comment_body: I have a new laptop with Windows 10 Pro version 1709. After installing [product_name] [version_no] (which previously worked fine on my old XP machine), I noticed that the menubar and toolbar appear extremely small. When opening any block parameters, such as the message block, the interface elements are also very tiny. Any advice would be appreciated.
Hello, The only solution I'm aware of is reducing your laptop's display resolution. In [product_name], the size of icons and interface elements can't be adjusted through settings. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing noticeable usability problems with [product_name] [version_no] software after switching to a newer Windows laptop. Due to inadequate UI scalability, elements such as toolbars and menus appear disproportionately small on high-resolution displays, making normal software use and configuration tasks challenging.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the software to provide a user-friendly experience across various screen resolutions, with scalable and easily readable toolbars and dialogs.
